description: This Java class 'EmailCampaignValidator' provides validation logic for email campaign data in the Fineract platform, including create, update, preview, activation, and closure validations.

classes.name: EmailCampaignValidator
classes.description: A validator class for email campaign data, ensuring required fields are present and valid for various operations such as create, update, preview, activate, and close.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating an email campaign, checking required fields and constraints.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an email campaign, ensuring fields are valid for update operations.

methods.name: validatePreviewMessage
methods.description: Validates JSON input for previewing an email message.

methods.name: validateClosedDate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for closing an email campaign, specifically the closure date.

methods.name: validateActivation
methods.description: Validates JSON input for activating an email campaign, specifically the activation date.

methods.name: validateClosure
methods.description: Validates JSON input for closing an email campaign, specifically the closure date.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if there are validation errors collected during validation.
